title: COLLAB_V1 Mission application request
description: POST /api/v1/missions/{missionId}/applications. Send a separate Idempotency-Key header (1-128 characters) and community:write credential. This schema describes the request body, not eligibility or selection. The application object is stored as uninterpreted JSON and its JSON.stringify length must not exceed 20,000 characters.

stage_id.description: stageId from the current GET applications contract preview

application.description: Optional applicant-provided context. No named field has server-defined meaning or influences hard eligibility in the current API.
